ui_bk_create_hint: config and state go into the backup; certificates do not (they are not ours)
ui_bk_empty: no backups yet — the first one appears after “Create” or on schedule
ui_bk_prune_hint: Old backups over the limit will be deleted permanently.
ui_bk_prune_note: {0} newest are kept; deleted ones cannot be brought back
ui_bk_restore_hint: Current settings will be replaced with the ones from the backup, and the service will be restarted. Nothing executable is restored from the archive — the service config is rebuilt from scratch.
ui_bk_restore_q: Restore “{0}”? Current settings will be replaced and the service restarted. Nothing executable is restored from the archive.
ui_cert_no_domain: no domain selected — the certificate is picked in the SSH wizard (godns → 1)
ui_cert_renew_hint: after renewal the service re-reads the certificate itself, without dropping connections
ui_cert_sec_renew_note: goDNS Pro only reads third-party certificates — no writes to /etc/letsencrypt
ui_chk_ext_confirm: The domain and port will be sent to a third-party reachability check service. The DoH secret path is not sent.
ui_chk_ext_note: host:port will go to a third-party service; the secret path will not
ui_chk_full_hint: the full check exercises TLS, DoH GET/POST, DNSSEC and upstream rotation — up to a couple of minutes
ui_chk_inside_note: the same checks as in the SSH menu
ui_chk_outside: From outside, via a third party
ui_chk_outside_note: “ss shows LISTEN” and “reachable from the internet” are different statements
ui_cn_addr_note: the DoH address contains the secret path — share it only with people you trust
ui_cn_dot_hint: enabled under “Ports and path”; needed for Android Private DNS
ui_cn_instr_note: the same text the SSH menu prints
ui_cn_qr_android_badport: DoT runs on port {0}, but Private DNS uses 853. Move DoT to 853.
ui_cn_qr_android_nodot: DoT is off — Android system Private DNS needs it. Enable DoT.
ui_cn_qr_android_scan: Scan on Android, paste into Private DNS:
ui_cn_qr_android_warn: This is DoT: hostname only, no https:// or port.
ui_cn_qr_ios_scan: Scan with the iPhone camera — Safari downloads the profile:
ui_cn_qr_note: The QR lasts 10 minutes and is one-time. The profile is unsigned — “Not Verified” on install is expected.
ui_err_notjson: the server did not answer with JSON
ui_lib_chart_gap: no data: the service or the server was down
ui_lib_job_timeout: the job did not finish in the allotted time
ui_ov_dot_off_hint: address hidden while DoT is off
ui_ov_gap_legend: downtime — service or server was down
ui_ov_sec_addr_note: the secret DoH path is part of the address — do not publish it
ui_ov_sec_dates_note: two dates: the registrar renews the registration, the certificate renews itself
ui_ov_sec_queries_note: "≈" — incomplete window: service or server restarted
ui_ov_slices_empty: collecting slices — numbers appear in a minute or two
ui_ports_dot_need_note: needed for Android Private DNS; DoT has no secret path
ui_ports_dot_open_note: DoT has no secret path: it is open to anyone who knows the domain
ui_ports_dotoff_warn: Android clients with Private DNS will lose DNS immediately after this is applied.
ui_ports_hint_busy: ports held by others are checked at apply time; our own running dnsdist does not count as busy
ui_ports_note_path: the path is part of the address: a new path cuts off ALL current clients
ui_ports_note_ports: after a port change clients need a new address
ui_ports_rotate_warn: All clients on the old address will drop off silently: dnsdist matches the path exactly and returns 404. Continue?
ui_ports_rotated_toast: path changed — give clients the new address
ui_svc_logs_hint: individual queries are not in the log — that is how dnsdist works, not a fault
ui_svc_restart_hint: restart rebuilds the config from config.json and applies it; the console key is hidden in the config view
ui_ups_btn_report: pull a report from the service
ui_ups_cu_enable: put into the active set right away
ui_ups_cu_enable_dirty: apply the changed set above first
ui_ups_cu_limit_reached: the limit of {0} own upstreams is reached — remove one
ui_ups_cu_need_host: enter a host or an IP
ui_ups_cu_note: DoT, DoH or plain DNS; DoT/DoH certificates are always validated — a self-signed one will not work
ui_ups_cu_plain_ack: I understand, add the plaintext upstream anyway
ui_ups_cu_plain_private: the address is private — queries to it stay inside your network
ui_ups_cu_plain_public: plain DNS to a public address: your clients’ queries leave for the internet UNENCRYPTED — the ISP and anyone on the path can read them
ui_ups_cu_probe_fail: did not answer: {0} — in service it will be marked down
ui_ups_cu_probing: probing the upstream… up to 60 s
ui_ups_cu_rm_hint: Remove {0} ({1} · {2})? If it is in the active set, the service reloads its configuration.
ui_ups_lat_hint: latency is not ping: a TLS handshake plus a query over an established connection; sorted by the warm number
ui_ups_need_one: at least one upstream is needed
ui_ups_report_note: dnsdist console: state and latency of warm connections
ui_ups_set_note: filtering resolvers are yellow: their NXDOMAIN looks like a broken tunnel
web_2fa_cooldown: a code was already sent, try again in {0} s
web_2fa_expired: the code has expired — request a new one
web_2fa_hourly: too many code requests, try again in an hour
web_2fa_msg_tail: If this was not you, simply do not enter it.
web_2fa_no_bot: the bot is not set up — nobody to send the code to
web_2fa_not_sent: could not send the code through the bot
web_2fa_sent: the code was sent to Telegram
web_2fa_too_many: too many attempts — request a new code
web_backup_name_bad: that does not look like a backup name
web_bench_summary: {0} resolvers measured, {1} answered; warm figures are in the table
web_cert_load_failed: [web] the certificate did not load ({0}); public access is unavailable
web_cmd_timeout: the command did not finish within {0} s
web_cu_bad_host: host: a name or an IP address without spaces or special characters
web_cu_bad_id: that does not look like an own upstream id
web_cu_bad_name: name: up to 40 characters, no | or ;
web_cu_bad_path: DoH path: starts with “/”, latin letters, digits, . _ ~ % - /
web_label_bad: label: latin letters and digits, dot and dash allowed, up to 40 characters
web_login_badjson: the server answered with something unreadable
web_login_hint: The code goes to the bot admin in Telegram. Valid for 5 minutes, single use.
web_login_sig_fail: the signature did not match — enter the code
web_need_agree: Consent required — type {0}: host:port will go to a third party
web_no_cert_listener: [web] no certificate — the public listener is not up; the SSH tunnel remains
web_port_range: port {0}: a number from 1 to 65535 is required
web_qr_profile_fail: Could not prepare the iPhone profile.
web_sig_bad: the Telegram signature was not confirmed
web_started: [web] goDNS Pro web v{0} started ({1} listeners)
web_token_save_failed: [web] could not save the token to {0}: {1}; keeping it in memory
web_ups_none: at least one upstream is required
